codeReview.summary: Implementation covers the requested dashboard UI behavior: month navigation, loading/error states, no-budget empty state, progress-bar color thresholds, budget modal create/edit flow, and responsive card layout. Tests provide broad coverage of these states and interactions.

issues.description: Progress bar width is applied with inline style (`style={{ width: ... }}`), which conflicts with the mission convention to use Tailwind utilities for styling and avoid inline styles.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The transcript skeleton shows implementation beginning with hooks/page creation before tests, while frontend-worker procedure mandates tests-first (TDD red phase). However, handoff.skillFeedback reports followedProcedure=true with no deviations.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: worker-transcripts.jsonl (session 57338793-309d-4266-9839-3f76e55bb2e5) skeleton includes: 'I'll begin with the hooks and then the DashboardPage' before Create calls for useDashboard.ts/useBudget.ts and later DashboardPage.test.tsx; handoff file reports skillFeedback.followedProcedure=true.

summary: Feature is functionally complete against expected behavior and validation targets, with one non-blocking styling convention violation and one skill-procedure reporting inconsistency noted for triage.
